remarks: Located in the desirable Glenbrook area, this bright and airy 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offers comfortable living and easy entertaining. The open first floor flows seamlessly from the living room to a private deck, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or unwinding with an evening beverage. Upstairs, the three spacious bedrooms provide a peaceful retreat, where you can open the windows and fall asleep to the soothing sounds of a babbling brook. The lower level offers endless possibilities, with a large bar making it perfect for a rec room, playroom, or media room-ideal for movie or sports nights. Enjoy quick access to everything Stamford and nearby Darien have to offer, including restaurants, entertainment, shopping, and more! **BRAND NEW ROOF & CARPET JUST INSTALLED**
